project: MC3 recomp truth audit and boot repair
overview: Audit the provenance of the ELF, Ghidra export, TOML, generated C++ and partial runner before changing runtime behavior. Then repair only evidence-backed build or boot blockers and verify real GS/GIF traffic.
goals: Establish whether the current ELF, Ghidra project, CSV, TOML and generated C++ describe the same game build.
Remove stale-path and stale-artifact ambiguity from the working pipeline.
Complete the missing partial-runner objects and relink only after the audit.
Find the first proven cause of zero GIF/GS traffic and apply only minimal env-gated fixes.
nonGoals: Do not rewrite the project from scratch.
Do not invent function bodies or arbitrary aliases.
Do not force semaphores, skip loops, or promote experiments without evidence.
Do not write to PCSX2 memory or launch fullscreen applications.
Do not claim graphical success while gif=0 or gsw=0.
successMetrics: The export provenance and path validity are recorded with hashes, counts and reproducible commands.
The partial runner relinks successfully with no unresolved manifest objects.
A fresh probe is run after relink and its raw log is inspected.
Real GIF/GS traffic is observed, or the exact first blocker is documented with evidence and no unsupported theory is presented as fact.
openQuestions: Is the Ghidra project in work\mc2recomp.gpr the source that produced the current 15,812-function CSV?
Are the extracted ELF and the ISO byte-identical to the source used for the export?
Which runtime path should produce the first real GIF/GS packet?
Does the sid=48 wait depend on a missing callback, a file/package response, or an incorrect generated function?
rules: Treat BRAIN.md, PS2_PROJECT_STATE.md, raw probe logs and current filesystem evidence as separate sources; report conflicts explicitly.
The TOML input/output fields must be traced to the exporter/recompiler before being called causal.
Hand-editing stale paths is not a valid export repair; rerun the exporter from the current workspace if provenance is invalid.
All runtime experiments remain env-gated and must include a negative result when they do not advance GIF/GS traffic.
Use the current workspace path E:\Emuladores\Sony\mc3recomp, never the stale D:\TARS paths.
qualityGates: Audit the current TOML, CSV, exporter Java and launcher scripts before mutation.
Compile the eight remaining batch_0015 objects with C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin on PATH.
Inspect work\boot_probe\latest_status.md and work\logs\14_run_boot_trace.log after every probe.
gif>0 and gsw>0 are required for graphical success; otherwise leave status as blocked.

stories.title: Audit provenance and stale paths
stories.description: As the project owner, I want proof that the ELF, Ghidra project, TOML, CSV and generated C++ refer to the same source so that later debugging is trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Record absolute current paths, file sizes, hashes where practical, function counts, CSV range sanity and TOML path validity.
Trace whether TOML input/output fields are consumed or only emitted metadata.
Example: a current-workspace export has paths under E:\Emuladores\Sony\mc3recomp.
Negative case: stale D:\TARS paths are not silently accepted as current evidence.
Write a concise audit note under docs with conflicts and confidence levels.

stories.title: Rebuild the partial runner inputs
stories.description: As the project owner, I want the known missing batch_0015 objects compiled so the runner can be relinked from a complete manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: Compile the eight missing objects using the verified compiler PATH.
Relink the partial runner without unresolved manifest objects.
Example: sub_002A4B98 produces the expected object path and the linker consumes it.
Negative case: a compile or link error is documented and no fake object is created.

stories.title: Run a fresh evidence probe
stories.description: As the project owner, I want a fresh boot trace after relink so stale PCs and classifications stop driving decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Run the canonical probe after the runner is relinked.
Record the raw stable PC, wait frame, SIF envelopes and dma/gif/gsw/vif counters.
Example: the report links the exact fresh log timestamp.
Negative case: render-started with gif=0 or gsw=0 is reported as no graphical success.

stories.title: Trace the first graphics and asset path
stories.description: As the project owner, I want the first real GIF/GS/VIF and texture-open path identified so fixes target the actual missing behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Map the first graphics call site and the first texture/package request from the fresh trace to generated code.
Compare static expectations with available PCSX2 read-only evidence when available.
Example: a trace names the producer expected to emit GIF/GS traffic.
Negative case: correlation alone is not recorded as causation.

stories.title: Apply only proven minimal repairs
stories.description: As the project owner, I want only evidence-backed fixes applied so the recomp does not become a pile of guesses.
acceptanceCriteria: Every runtime change is env-gated, logged and tied to a concrete static or live observation.
Rebuild, relink and rerun the probe after each small change.
Example: a callback or response shim is accepted only if it advances the fresh trace toward GIF/GS traffic.
Negative case: failed experiments remain disabled and are documented with their regression.
